claim_text: The official Codex CLI provides a documented non-interactive codex exec surface suitable for bounded research subprocess invocation.
actakit_transfer: Keep the research harness outside actakit/ and pass only selected material plus a fixed prompt/schema.

claim_text: codex exec supports ephemeral execution, read-only sandbox defaults, image attachments, explicit model selection and output-schema structured final responses.
actakit_transfer: Use the least-permission sandbox, --ephemeral, selected images and a committed schema; never expose the repository.

claim_text: Codex can be authenticated through a ChatGPT plan separately from API-key authentication.
actakit_transfer: Classify Codex as subscription-backed agent execution; ActaKit never reads or stores the credential.

claim_text: ChatGPT/Codex allowance and limits are account/plan dependent and are not a per-call API price signal.
actakit_transfer: Record subscription billing mode without fabricating dollar cost, quota, account identity or usage-dashboard data.
